gates.note: Full production build passed before the final two-selector navigation-hover correction. That CSS correction was compiled through the same PostCSS pipeline, verified in the real shared-component browser fixture, and included in a fresh desktop build.

gates.command: Focused Auth and shared invitation regressions

failures.test: does not run a stale branch inside a loop
delivers one call per loop iteration, in order

gates.investigation: These executor files and their production owners are unchanged. Both failures reproduce with bundled and official Node 24.19.0, including with the Vitest filesystem cache disabled. Both files pass all 22 tests under Node 23.10.0. No executor or test-timeout workaround was added to the Auth redesign.

productionBrowser.name: Header preserves nested callback and invitation context
Password visibility preserves input and does not submit
Recovery keeps the email and original return URL
Real invalid sign-in response remains visible and associated
Auth is noindex over real HTTP
Signup retains the legacy redirect parameter in its header
Signup validation messages wrap without overlay at 320px

productionVisualAndIsolation.name: Mobile uses text navigation and support follows the form
Desktop uses pill navigation, 400px form and flow footer
App dark mode and brand variables do not change Auth typography or control colors
Auth suppresses configured deployment custom CSS
Auth content and robots metadata are server rendered without JavaScript

deploymentConfigurations.name: Server-only registration policy hides signup after hydration
SSO-only policy keeps its primary action and removes email/recovery/signup controls
No-methods deployment provides an explicit unavailable state
All-provider configuration matches the specified ordering and mobile two-column layout

realAccountLifecycle.name: Real signup reaches verification with callback retained
Invalid OTP has visible associated feedback
Mail-delivered OTP verifies once and returns to the requested page
Recovery sends a real reset email and retains its neutral acknowledgement
Reset validates mismatch, changes password, and returns to login
New password signs in through the existing session handler

sharedControls.name: Select keyboard skips disabled options and returns focus
Search filters options and keeps keyboard selection
Copy announces success then returns to Copy
Account menu executes only its existing switch action
OTP paste fills six slots and pending prevents duplicate actions
Long menu and controls fit viewport 320
Long menu and controls fit viewport 390
Long menu and controls fit viewport 768
Long menu and controls fit viewport 1440

nativeElectron.name: Actual Electron loads the isolated offline screen and bundled fonts
Native Change server opens the existing dialog with current URL
Native server validation retains input and fits resized content
Native Escape dismisses the existing server window

navigationInteractionColors.name: Desktop navigation keeps dark fill and readable white text during hover and press
Mobile navigation remains quiet text during hover

liveInfrastructure: Disposable local PostgreSQL, Mailpit SMTP, production Next server and actual Electron; no production accounts or external provider credentials used.
limitations: The full monorepo test gate is not green because of the two Node 24 executor timeouts listed above.
Live external-provider and enterprise-tenant flows were not exercised. The route/state inventory is not an assertion that every provider or policy branch was executed.
Bun 1.4.1 is installed locally; the repository declares Bun 1.4.4. The Node 24 runtime used for validation was isolated without changing the global installation.
Browser screenshots and raw execution logs are local review artifacts; the checks and outcomes are recorded here without credentials, OTPs or handoff tokens.
